name: cell-fused
description: Cell list and aggregation weights from cell sizes; per-cohort Newton fits (logit or tilting, weighted least squares) shared across cells with identical units and warm-started otherwise; one fused Numba pass over units for every cell's influence function and the simple, group, calendar and event-study aggregates (no n_units x n_cells matrices); exact reference operations for numerically-zero or singular cells. Threads: NUMBA_NUM_THREADS.
